summary: Full backend + frontend testing of EU Labor Market Copilot. All 6 pytest cases passed (schema, top-5 bar, line trend, multi-series, SQL-injection safety with row-count check, history). Frontend Playwright run confirmed the sample card click DOES trigger POST /api/chat (200), copilot-message-1 with chart-container-1 rendered, SQL toggle + copy work, table toggle works, textarea+submit sent a second POST /api/chat (200), Schema dialog lists all 5 columns, and Clear returns to empty state. Total 2 POSTs observed with 200 responses.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render. Chart still renders correctly after layout, but the warning suggests ResponsiveContainer parent has no explicit min-height on first paint. Consider giving chart wrapper an explicit height (e.g. h-72) instead of relying on aspect ratio.

action_items: Optional: Add explicit height to ResultChart wrapper to silence recharts width/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py summarize() has an operator-precedence bug on line: 'elif numeric_vals and not chart.get("series") or (chart.get("series") == [y]):' — 'and not X or Y' parses as '(A and not X) or Y' which likely wasn't intended. Wrap in parentheses: 'elif numeric_vals and (not chart.get("series") or chart.get("series") == [y])'.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context.
No pagination limit on GET /api/history (hard-coded 500) — fine for MVP.
validate_sql rejects any ';' which prevents even a trailing semicolon inside quoted strings; acceptable for this scope.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded SQLite DB (280 rows verified unchanged after injection test). One TEST_session_history_1 mongo doc created via history test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~20s (6 tests). Frontend flow via sample-prompt-card-0 was previously suspected broken but is CONFIRMED WORKING — POST /api/chat fires and chart renders. Row count in SQLite must stay 280.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing bugs. Previous agent's failure to observe POSTs was likely due to short screenshot-only run without waiting for the async request.
